Causes of Death by Country

Source: vignettes/causes_of_death.qmd
Chart
Table
Notes

Data summary

  • 26 countries — top 20 by population plus OECD member states
  • 14 causes of death — 7 non-communicable + 7 infectious
  • Metric: age-standardised death rate per 100,000 population
  • Source: IHME Global Burden of Disease 2019, via OWID catalog (snapshot 2024-05-20)
  • Percentage shares are relative to these 14 tracked causes only — not 100% of all-cause mortality

Exclusions

  • Ireland — listed in the download script's country filter (IRL) but absent from the bundled OWID snapshot. Requires IHME GBD Results Tool direct download — see #94
  • Injuries (road accidents, self-harm, violence, falls, drowning) — a major cause-of-death category, especially in younger age groups. Not yet included — see #91
  • Maternal and neonatal deaths — account for ~10% of deaths in low-income countries. Not yet included
  • Other NCDs (neurological, mental, musculoskeletal) — not in the 7 tracked NCD categories
Data staleness warning
GBD data year: 2019 — the most recent year in the bundled snapshot.
OWID catalog date: 2024-05-20 — this URL now returns HTTP 404. OWID restricted GBD redistribution due to IHME licensing changes.
GBD 2023 is available from IHME (free account required) — see #90.

Glossary

  • GBD — Global Burden of Disease study (IHME)
  • IHME — Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation
  • OWID — Our World in Data
  • NCD — Non-communicable diseases
  • CVD — Cardiovascular disease
  • LRI — Lower respiratory infections
  • DALY — Disability-adjusted life year

References

  • IHME. Global Burden of Disease Study 2019 (GBD 2019) Results. Seattle: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation, 2020. GBD Results Tool
  • Ritchie H, Spooner F, Roser M. Causes of death. Our World in Data, 2018 (updated 2024). ourworldindata.org/causes-of-death
  • Roth GA et al. Global burden of 369 diseases and injuries, 1990–2019. Lancet 2020; 396:1204–22. doi:10.1016/S0140-6736(20)30925-9
